title: Bold Venture
paragraphs: Humphrey Bogart and Lauren Bacall star as Slate Shannon and Sailor Duval in a Caribbean adventure series centered on Shannon's Place in Havana and the charter boat Bold Venture, where smugglers, killers, revolutionaries, and desperate travelers draw them into danger.

Star-led Caribbean adventure series produced for transcription syndication. The GRH snapshot contains 54 distinct playable programs from a documented 78-program run; all frozen rows are undated, and multiple collector/Ziv numbering systems conflict.
GRH documents the program through Ziv syndicated run (March 26, 1951 to September 15, 1952).

Among the most extensively documented contributors in the GRH holdings are David Friedkin (writer on 54 recordings), David Rose (composer on 54 recordings and conductor on 54 recordings), Henry Hayward (director on 54 recordings), Humphrey Bogart (performer on 54 recordings), Lauren Bacall (performer on 54 recordings), and Morton Fine (writer on 54 recordings).

Its indexed subjects and listening characteristics include Caribbean adventure, Havana and Cuba, murder and homicide, boats, ships and maritime travel, treasure, jewels and valuables, and smuggling and contraband.
GRH also places the series in documented historical contexts including Ziv transcription syndication, Hollywood stars in syndicated radio, Caribbean adventure setting, and Calypso musical framing.
